hook.name: TaxHook
hook.description: Charges a 1% tax on every swap in the specified pool pairs (ETH/FRAC and MEME/FRAC): ETH tax is accumulated in the contract and forwarded to a team wallet via `sweep()`; MEME tax is burned to address(0xdead). Tax is deducted in `beforeSwap` or `afterSwap` depending on whether the taxed currency is the specified or unspecified leg.
